scenario: A machine-readable paper business validation report disables or omits the fresh authorization gate required before real content or live WriteLab use.
input_report_features: business_validation_report.json sets runtime_authorization_required_for_real_content=false and has no authorization_gate.fresh_authorization, no human_gate_ref, and no RuntimeAuthorization artifact. The report still marks candidate_status='pass' and states that the same result may be reused for real paper text later.
expected_findings: Fresh authorization gate is missing for real content or live WriteLab escalation
Synthetic/offline evidence cannot be reused as real-content authorization
Missing RuntimeAuthorization or human_gate_ref boundary record
